comment: Lindos WinApps catalog (SPEC-VM section 22). Each entry needs a user-supplied, licensed Windows with the app installed in the backend. Lindos never downloads Windows or bypasses licensing. rdp_path is the usual Windows install path; adjust it in the generated .desktop or re-run install if your version differs.

apps.name: Adobe Photoshop
apps.note: Needs a licensed Adobe Photoshop installed in the Windows backend. Lindos does not provide or license Photoshop.

apps.name: Adobe Illustrator
apps.note: Needs a licensed Adobe Illustrator installed in the Windows backend.

apps.name: Adobe Premiere Pro
apps.rdp_path: C:\Program Files\Adobe\Adobe Premiere Pro 2024\Adobe Premiere Pro.exe
apps.note: Needs a licensed Adobe Premiere Pro installed in the Windows backend.

apps.name: Microsoft Word
apps.note: Needs a licensed Microsoft Office (Word) installed in the Windows backend.

apps.name: Microsoft Excel
apps.note: Needs a licensed Microsoft Office (Excel) installed in the Windows backend.

apps.name: Microsoft PowerPoint
apps.note: Needs a licensed Microsoft Office (PowerPoint) installed in the Windows backend.

apps.name: Microsoft Outlook
apps.note: Needs a licensed Microsoft Office (Outlook) installed in the Windows backend.

apps.name: Windows File Explorer
apps.note: Generic Windows Explorer window from the backend. Needs a running Windows backend.
